steps.title: What our P&T committee already approved
steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

steps.title: Which links can't be trusted
steps.purpose: Run the semantic layer's key rules (NDC and unit of use) over each hospital's stock, and name the rows they reject.
steps.finding: 11 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 0 of them are this drug. Every row is in a shared unit of use.

steps.title: What we decided last time
steps.purpose: Recall past decisions on this drug from H-MEM, with who approved them.
steps.finding: No past decisions on this drug.

explanation.headline: Baclofen is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; on-hand supply ranges from 23.9 to 34.2 days across sites

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include baclofen as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 199 tablets of baclofen 20 mg with 34.2 days on hand at 5.8 tablets per day.
Corvale General holds 198 tablets of baclofen 20 mg with 23.9 days on hand at 8.3 tablets per day.
Corvale Lakeside holds 54 tablets of baclofen 20 mg with 28.1 days on hand at 1.9 tablets per day.
The label for NDC 71335249700 names Bryant Ranch Prepack as the plant (FEI 1000519407) with a VAI inspection on 2026-07-16.
FDA records show Bryant Ranch Prepack received an OAI classification in 2009 and a Warning Letter on 2010-04-08, followed by multiple VAI inspections through 2026-07-16.
The rule-based alternate manufacturer ranked first is Advagen Pharma Limited, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.
